1072: pub open spec fn LogRangeMatchesQueue<DT: Dispatch>(
1073:     queue: Seq<ReqId>,
1074:     log: Map<LogIdx, LogEntry<DT>>,

1076:     logIndexLower: LogIdx,
1077:     logIndexUpper: LogIdx,
1078:     nodeId: NodeId,
1079:     updates: Map<ReqId, UpdateState<DT>>,
1080: ) -> bool {
1081:     recommends([0 <= queueIndex <= queue.len(), LogContainsEntriesUpToHere(log, logIndexUpper)]);
1082:     decreases_when(logIndexLower <= logIndexUpper);
1083:     decreases(logIndexUpper - logIndexLower);
1084:     &&& (logIndexLower == logIndexUpper ==> queueIndex
1085:         == queue.len())
1086: 
1087:     &&& (logIndexLower < logIndexUpper ==> {
1088:         &&& log.contains_key(
1089:             logIndexLower,
1090:         )
1091: 
1092:         &&& (log.index(logIndexLower).node_id == nodeId ==> {
1093:             &&& queueIndex < queue.len()
1094:             &&& updates.contains_key(queue.index(queueIndex as int))
1095:             &&& updates.index(queue.index(queueIndex as int)).is_Placed()
1096:             &&& updates.index(queue.index(queueIndex as int)).get_Placed_idx() == logIndexLower
1097:             &&& LogRangeMatchesQueue(
1098:                 queue,
1099:                 log,
1100:                 queueIndex + 1,
1101:                 logIndexLower + 1,
1102:                 logIndexUpper,
1103:                 nodeId,
1104:                 updates,
1105:             )
1106:         })
1107: 
1108:         &&& (log.index(logIndexLower).node_id != nodeId ==> LogRangeMatchesQueue(
1109:             queue,
1110:             log,
1111:             queueIndex,
1112:             logIndexLower + 1,
1113:             logIndexUpper,
1114:             nodeId,
1115:             updates,
1116:         ))
1117:     })
1118: }

proof fn LogRangeMatchesQueue_append_other<DT: Dispatch>(
    queue: Seq<nat>,
    log: Map<nat, LogEntry<DT>>,
    new_log: Map<nat, LogEntry<DT>>,
    queueIndex: nat,
    logIndexLower: nat,
    logIndexUpper: nat,
    logLen: nat,
    node_id: NodeId,
    updates: Map<ReqId, UpdateState<DT>>,
    new_updates: Map<ReqId, UpdateState<DT>>,
    new_rid: ReqId,
    log_entry: LogEntry<DT>,
)
    requires
        0 <= queueIndex <= queue.len(),
        logIndexLower <= logIndexUpper <= logLen,
        log_entry.node_id != node_id,
        new_updates.contains_key(new_rid),
        new_updates.index(new_rid) === (UpdateState::Placed { op: log_entry.op, idx: logLen }),
        !queue.contains(new_rid),
        forall|rid| #[trigger]
            updates.contains_key(rid) && rid != new_rid ==> new_updates.contains_key(rid)
                && new_updates[rid] === updates[rid],
        LogRangeMatchesQueue(
            queue,
            log,
            queueIndex,
            logIndexLower,
            logIndexUpper,
            node_id,
            updates,
        ),
        new_log === log.insert(logLen, log_entry),
